name: Read persisted ext domain
description: On reconfigure, reads ZITADEL_EXTERNALDOMAIN back from the persisted /config/zitadel.yaml (ExternalDomain) so it keeps the install-time value instead of dropping to the hostname default. Without this, reconfigure regenerates docker-compose with Host:<hostname>, the API reports 'instance not found', and the login-v2 renders an empty form. No-op on fresh install (no persisted yaml).
